# Jobs

For the 2026 summer season we are looking for:

- a cook (100%)
- a service team member (80 to 100%)

We offer a small team, a room in the staff house and days off in the mountains.

Send your application to jobs@laerchenwald.example. Seraina Muster answers questions on +41 81 555 01 30.
